caption:
Chasing a holier rule and still empty? That's the counterfeit. (1 Timothy 4:1–2 devotional)

Deception rarely arrives looking evil — it arrives looking holier. A stricter rule can quietly push grace out and leave you emptier than before. Check your faith by thanks for grace, not by a scoreboard of rules.

📌 Save this for your quiet time this week
💬 Comment below — where might “stricter” have crowded out grace for you?
